title: Unauthenticated destructive debug routes (/stop, /clear, /init) enabled by default
description: Verified: podex.ps1:87-93 registers api/debug/*.ps1 as unauthenticated top-level GET routes whenever Podex.Debug is true, and server.psd1:39 ships Podex.Debug = $true by default. GET /stop (api/debug/stop.ps1:5) calls Close-PodeServer (DoS); /clear and /init run DROP TABLE + recreate against the live DB. No auth, no CSRF token, GET-triggerable by anyone who can reach the port.
notes: Coupling: shares the server.psd1:39 Podex.Debug=$true default with audit-codebase-analysis-1783691802-show-exceptions-disclosure and remediation-20260710-debug-hotpath-writes. If Podex.Debug defaults to $false first, the debug route registration (podex.ps1:87-93) stops firing by default and this feature's urgency drops — coordinate scheduling across the three so the server.psd1 change is made once, consistently. | Added by feature-review 2026-07-10. | Resolution (2026-07-10): Set Podex.Debug=$false by default in server.psd1 (per .aidd/responses.md: Debug must default OFF with explicit local-dev opt-in, destructive debug routes gated behind Debug). Extracted the file-based route auto-loader's gating into a pure, testable helper api/_lib/route-registration.ps1 (Resolve-ApiRouteRegistration): it returns $null (skip Add-PodeRoute) for /debug/* files whenever Debug is off, so /stop, /clear, /init are ABSENT under the default config rather than merely relocated to /api/debug/* (the prior loop's else->GET branch registered GET /api/debug/stop even with Debug off). podex.ps1 now delegates to it. Added 6 Pester tests asserting the debug routes are absent by default, not relocated, and only appear as GET when Debug is on. npm test 56/56 pass; npm run analyze 0 errors. Left Web.ErrorPages.ShowExceptions to the coupled show-exceptions feature.
spec:
Detailed remediation steps:
1. Do not register /stop, /clear, /init unless an explicit, non-default local-dev flag is set (separate from general Debug logging).
2. If retained for dev, require POST (not GET) and a shared secret / localhost-only binding.
3. Consider defaulting Podex.Debug to $false in server.psd1 and documenting how to enable it locally.
4. Add a test asserting these routes are absent under default configuration.
